finding: The engine separates 2018-2021 discovery, 2022-2023 validation, and 2024-2025 historical evaluation, labels the latter as already inspected, and rejects protected 2026 paths before reading them.
recommended_change: Keep the current boundary and never relabel 2024-2025 as an untouched holdout. Require a separately authorized prospective/future protocol for new evidence.

finding: Completed-bar timestamps, feature cutoffs, causal pivots, post-entry feature exclusions, deterministic replay, and an explicit 2026 pre-read guard are tested.
recommended_change: Retain invariant tests for every new feature and require metadata declaring feature availability time, not merely observation time.

finding: Equity-universe survivorship is not applicable to a single continuous NQ/MNQ futures series, but point-in-time contract mapping and roll selection are analogous and can still create selection leakage.
recommended_change: Add a roll-by-roll audit that records the active contract known at each timestamp, mapping changes, gaps, duplicated minutes, and any back-adjustment policy.

finding: The single-market design avoids equity delisting bias, while retrospective Reddit idea selection and repeated candidate tournaments remain a material selection-bias channel.
recommended_change: Keep every attempted rule in the experiment registry, count shadow and rejected variants in the search family, and preserve source-vintage warnings.

finding: Session-aligned stationary bootstrap, BH/BY corrections, White reality check, SPA-style testing, Deflated Sharpe, and PBO are implemented with 50,000 resamples in Phase 7.
recommended_change: Before any new tournament, freeze the complete family—including controls and abandoned variants—and report family-level results even when no candidate passes.

finding: Chronological folds and expanding walk-forward audits exist, but all 2018-2025 observations are now known and cannot supply new holdout evidence.
recommended_change: Use walk-forward only as historical stability evidence. Freeze any future model selection cadence and hyperparameter grid before prospective evaluation.

finding: Plateaus and sensitivity checks exist in prior phases, but no single reusable promotion gate appears to reject unstable parameter neighborhoods automatically.
recommended_change: Add a generic stability report: neighboring-parameter sign consistency, rank persistence by fold/year, degradation under cost stress, and rejection when the winner is an isolated peak.

finding: NQ/MNQ point values and fee schedules are separate; direction-aware slippage, spread, commissions, exchange/clearing/regulatory fees, tick rounding, gap-through stops, adverse-first ambiguous bars, and gross-to-net reconciliation are tested.
recommended_change: Keep one-minute OHLCV limitations explicit. Do not claim queue, order-book, footprint, true delta, or market-impact fidelity; calibrate slippage only from timestamped forward fills.

finding: Deterministic historical replay is covered, but there is no shared strategy runtime proving that backtest, shadow, paper, and future live modes consume identical signals and order semantics.
recommended_change: Create a common event-driven strategy adapter and a golden-replay test comparing signal, intended order, simulated fill, broker fill, fees, position, and P&L at every transition.

finding: Session checks detect duplicate and unordered timestamps, missing key New York bars, extreme ranges, and mapping changes, but acceptance is narrow and does not persist a full anomaly ledger.
recommended_change: Persist per-partition checksums and anomaly counts for OHLC consistency, zero/negative prices, volume anomalies, missing intervals by session calendar, roll discontinuities, and duplicate instrument mappings.

finding: Position sizing, margin caps, drawdown, tail concentration, cost stress, best-trade removal, and descriptive portfolio combinations exist. Portfolio allocation is not yet a production risk service.
recommended_change: Implement account-level exposure, correlated-strategy risk, daily loss, rolling drawdown, stale-price, and maximum-open-risk limits independent of strategy code.

finding: The prospective paper journal is immutable and append-only, but it is manual, has no broker connection, and lacks quantitative promotion gates based on realized fill quality and operational reliability.
recommended_change: Define frozen gates for minimum prospective sessions, fill slippage tolerance, missing-signal rate, reconciliation errors, drawdown, rule deviations, and zero unresolved incidents before any live authorization.

finding: No production heartbeat, broker/account reconciliation, stale-data alert, rejected-order alert, position mismatch detector, or incident state is implemented.
recommended_change: Add an append-only operational event ledger plus health dashboard for data freshness, signal latency, intended-versus-realized fills, order status, positions, cash, fees, and alert acknowledgement.

finding: SQLite WAL and immutable paper events preserve journal history, but order submission/retry IDs, restart state reconstruction, duplicate-order prevention, and broker reconciliation are absent.
recommended_change: Use deterministic client-order IDs, durable state transitions, at-least-once event handling with idempotent effects, startup reconciliation, and tests for crashes at every order lifecycle boundary.

finding: Research-level daily loss and margin limits exist, but no live kill switch or fail-closed behavior exists because the application has no broker execution layer.
recommended_change: Implement manual and automatic disable controls for stale data, excessive slippage, repeated rejects, position mismatch, daily loss, drawdown, connectivity loss, and duplicate orders; require explicit reset with audit trail.

finding: The research artifacts diagnose regime decay and tail dependence historically, but no frozen prospective degradation monitor or shutdown decision rule exists.
recommended_change: Pre-register rolling realized-versus-expected slippage, expectancy, drawdown, tail contribution, missed-signal rate, and control-relative performance thresholds with warning, pause, and retire states.

finding: Frozen specifications, hashes, experiment registries, deterministic seeds, raw-cache checksums, and artifact regression tests are strong.
recommended_change: Extend the same hash-and-registry discipline to paper configuration, runtime version, broker adapter, incidents, and every prospective signal/fill record.

finding: Corporate actions and delisted-equity point-in-time membership do not apply to NQ/MNQ futures bars.
recommended_change: No equity corporate-action subsystem is needed unless the application expands to stocks; keep futures roll handling as the relevant analogue.
